caption: The drawing consists of three rectangular sections, each containing a separate botanical motif on a beige, textured background. The top-left section features a flower with pink and red petals, a blue central stem, and green leaves, accompanied by some smaller blue and brown elements and a brown, wavy base. The top-right section displays a small tree or shrub with branching limbs, predominantly brown with green and orange leaves. The bottom-left section contains three light blue, thistle-like flowers with yellow centers and brown stems, along with smaller brown leaves and buds. Each motif is rendered in fine detail with colored pencils or ink, and the sections are arranged within a single bordered area on a cream-colored page. Handwritten text appears to the right of the top section, reading "Single motifs on spread. scale 4" to 1'." The signature "Mary Farmer" is written in cursive at the bottom right of the bordered area.
title: Bedspread
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
